# dsh-agent-rules
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Rules & Memory** page to Settings and keeps long-lived prese
t rules in one editable list.
Rules are rendered into the managed block of `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`. The bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent
-instructions` loader reads that file as workspace instructions on the first request of every sessio
n, so the rules apply globally without occupying the system prompt.
## Behaviour
- **One list, one file.** The panel writes `~/.dsh/agent-rules.json` and re-renders the managed bloc

k of `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` on every change.
- **Manual content is preserved.** Everything outside the `
` / `` markers is left untouched. When hand-written content is detected, the panel offers to import

it into the list.
- **Disabled rules stay on disk.** Turning a rule off removes it from `AGENTS.md`

but keeps its text and ID in the JSON store.
- **No system-prompt rewrite.** The plugin does not hoo

k prompt assembly. It writes the file the official instruction loader already reads.
- **Open conver
sations are caught up.** A conversation receives the full list as workspace instructions when it sta
rts. When rules change afterwards, its next turn carries one reminder containing only the added or e
dited rules; removed or disabled ones are announced in a single line. The comparison anchors on the
rules parsed out of that conversation's own baseline message, so nothing is replayed twice.

## Usage
Settings → **规则与记忆** (Rules & Memory).
| Control | Effect |

| Add rule | Opens an editor at the top of the list; saving writes both files |
| Click rule text /

gear icon | Edit in place |
| Dot toggle | Disable without deleting; the rule stops being written to

`AGENTS.md` |
| Trash icon | Delete the rule from the store and from `AGENTS.md` |
| Import from AG
ENTS.md | Shown when hand-written content exists outside the managed block |
